# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 18 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 34 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_018_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 18

**1** The disciples said to Jesus: "Tell us how our end [хае] will come."

**2** Jesus said: "Have you discovered [хе] the beginning [архн], then, that you are seeking [шине] the end? For where the beginning is, there the end will be.

**3** Blessed [маkаріос] is the one who will stand at the beginning [архн] — that one will not taste death [мою]."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *хае*: end, last; the disciples ask an eschatological question
- *архн*: beginning, origin; Greek loan-word ἀρχή — source, principle
- *маkаріос*: blessed; beatitude form
- The question about the end (eschatology) is redirected to the beginning (protology)
- "Where the beginning is, there the end will be" — the Alpha/Omega structure: beginning and end are the same place
- "Stand at the beginning" — to find one's origin is to stand already at the goal
- "Will not taste death" — echo of Saying 1; the beatitude closes the circle

---
